description: Call this before repeating any Hydrex APR or yield projection. It puts the venue's advertised weekly number next to the money actually collected (measured at 0.089% of the projection), and computes live from the venue's own per-gauge data why the ceiling is structural: total fees and bribes the whole venue distributes, against the fraction of system votes a position actually holds. Free, keyless, read-only.
name: hydrex_reality
title: Hydrex measured income versus advertised projection, side by side
